1	# PLAN Wave 2 — winlog learning, exec dashboard, Databricks intake, KPI truth
     2	Visionary: Claude · Mode: audit continuation · For the Integrator to attack (you already audited these seams and returned APPROVED on feasibility — this plan binds them to rocks).
     3	
     4	## Goal
     5	Top management sees real sourcing KPIs at a glance; every accepted meeting becomes a structured, learnable win record; hiring needs originating in Databricks flow into the same intake→sourcing loop — all real data, zero synthetic, keys encrypted.
     6	
     7	## Non-goals
     8	Billing, mobile (Owner). Email open-tracking infrastructure (open rate shown as "not yet measured" until a tracking decision — no fake numbers). Databricks MCP (agent-conversational access) — Statement Execution API only this wave. Wave-3 refinements parked: durable server-side email-reply ingestion, server-loaded campaign objects for sourcing-agent, LinkedIn manual-send server ledger row.
     9	
    10	## Verified seams (from your audit + 3-agent research — attack any that look wrong)
    11	- WINLOG: single choke point createBookingFor commit (store.ts:3471-3496); all 5 booking call paths flow through it; in scope: candidate (sourcePlatform, matchScore, outreachHistory[{channel,at,...}], replyHistory), campaign, booking, full HermesState. touchCount = outreachHistory.length; winningChannel = last outreach entry channel; timeToBookMs = booking.createdAt − earliest outreach at; triggering reply intent from prev.replies. No server bookings table — HermesState JSONB persists wins for free. Existing learning layer: SkillUpdate + learnedParamsFor (skills.ts:182-251) takes aggregate signals — the WinRecord feeds it structured data. Weekly-report "winning patterns" are illustrative strings (mock-ai.ts:1440) — NOT truth; do not reuse.
    12	- DASHBOARD: extend src/lib/metrics.ts (globalKpis :155-192, computeCampaignMetrics :94-138) with per-platform/per-campaign funnels from candidates.sourcePlatform × outreach channel × ledger status × bookings. New read-only /exec page reusing existing UI patterns (mission-control HUD derivations, TrendSpark, trust-page tiles). Open rate: NOT measurable today (no email-open events; only WhatsApp has receipt events via 0010 migration) — render as "not tracked yet", never a fake number.
    13	- KPI TRUTH (prerequisite): 'contacted' is inconsistent — metrics.ts counts candidate stage high-water; HUD counts ledger status==='sent'. ONE canonical definition (ledger/outreach send facts) in metrics.ts, consumed by both.
    14	- DATABRICKS (verified docs.databricks.com): POST {host}/api/2.0/sql/statements, Bearer auth; OAuth M2M service principal (POST {host}/oidc/v1/token, client_credentials, scope=all-apis, ~1h token, cache ~55min) or PAT for dev; parameterized statement (:since, TIMESTAMP) — never string-interpolate; wait_timeout='30s', on_wait_timeout='CONTINUE', disposition=INLINE, format=JSON_ARRAY (≤25MiB), row_limit guard; poll GET /api/2.0/sql/statements/{id} if PENDING; map manifest.schema.columns onto data_array (values arrive stringified). Keys via encrypted api_keys ("Databricks" provider, same pattern as Tavily/Apollo). Rows map into the intake shape → createCampaignFromAnalysis (the same path a pasted email takes).
    15	
    16	## Standards (unchanged from Wave 1 + these)
    17	Zero synthetic data in exec metrics — provenance-filter demo candidates out of live KPIs or label demo mode loudly. Honest gaps ("not tracked yet") over invented numbers. All secrets encrypted (DATA_ENCRYPTION_KEY set). Gate stays green. Reduced-motion + responsive on /exec.
    18	
    19	## Rocks (build order)
    20	- **Rock W1 — KPI truth**: canonical metric definitions in metrics.ts, REAL-FACT based: contacted = distinct candidates with a REAL COMPLETED send fact — OutreachMessage.dryRun === false AND sentAt != null (or a provider/server-ledger terminal status:'sent'; manual LinkedIn confirm at store.ts:2660-2685 and provider-send transitions at store.ts:2813-2821 are the counting points). NOT ledger status:'sent' alone (demo dry-run writes those, store.ts:2537-2585) and NOT dryRun:false alone (live approval sets dryRun:false with sentAt:null while ledger is only 'claimed' — approved≠sent). Live KPIs additionally exclude candidate.provenance === 'synthetic'. replyRate/positiveRate/booked similarly fact-based. Consumed by globalKpis, campaign metrics, AND the HUD (one source). Proof: `npx tsx tests/metrics-canonical.mts` with a fixture including THREE trap cases — (a) demo dry-run 'sent' (dryRun:true), (b) live approved-unsent (dryRun:false, sentAt:null, ledger 'claimed'), (c) synthetic candidate — asserting ALL THREE are excluded, plus HUD/metrics agreement.
    21	- **Rock W2 — WinRecord + winlog** (consumes W1's real-fact model): `wins: WinRecord[]` on HermesState appended atomically in createBookingFor's commit ({candidateId, name, campaignId, bookingId, at, sourcePlatform, leadSource, matchScore, seniority, role title, outreachChannel, touchCount (real COMPLETED sends per W1: dryRun:false AND sentAt!=null), timeToBookMs, triggeringReplyIntent, messageTraits via explicit join candidate.outreachHistory[].messageId → state.outreach}). BOUNDED: cap wins at 500 newest (FIFO trim in the same commit) to protect the JSONB doc. Export: PRIVATE, authenticated in-app view + download ONLY (candidate PII — never written to docs/, public/, _relay/, .rocket-fuel/, never committed). Wins feed learnedParamsFor as structured signals (skills.ts). Proof: `npx tsx tests/winlog.mts` — drive a booking on fixture state incl. dry-run touches, assert structured win with correct REAL touchCount/channel/timing + cap behavior; export path is in-app only (grep assert no docs/public write).
    22	- **Rock W3 — /exec dashboard**: read-only exec page: KPI tiles (sourced, contacted, reply rate, positive-reply rate, meetings booked, time-to-source, avg match score), per-platform funnel, per-campaign funnel, trend sparklines, wins feed (from W2), open-rate tile labeled "not tracked yet". RBAC: viewer may see aggregate, PII-redacted tiles only; admin required for export/config; page-session gated by proxy in live. Demo mode banners itself as synthetic and excludes nothing (it IS the demo); LIVE mode excludes provenance:'synthetic' AND dryRun:true from every tile (per W1). Proof: `npx tsx tests/exec-dashboard.mts` — fixture asserts synthetic+dryRun exclusion in live derivations, canonical-metrics agreement, no Math.random/hardcoded metric constants (grep assert), viewer-vs-admin gating, renders (login-page.mts style).
    23	- **Rock W4 — Databricks intake** (config first, then route): dedicated DatabricksSettings integration config on workspace settings ({host, warehouseId, authMode: 'pat'|'m2m', clientId?, apiKeyId → encrypted api_keys ref, needsQuery template}) — api_keys alone is insufficient (no config fields; SystemSettings has none today). "Databricks" added to API_KEY_PROVIDERS + validator for the SECRET only. /api/integrations/databricks/needs route (admin/source-RBAC, prodFailClosed, rate-limited): host MUST pass assertPublicUrl (SSRF guard — private-link/internal workspaces explicitly OUT OF SCOPE this wave, documented); OAuth M2M (clientId from config + secret from vault, token cached ≤55min) or PAT; parameterized statement (:since) — never interpolated; INLINE JSON_ARRAY, row_limit guard; PENDING→poll. Returns PROPOSED ParsedIntake drafts ONLY — the server NEVER calls createCampaignFromAnalysis; human confirms in the intake UI (same flow as pasted email). Proof: `npx tsx tests/databricks-intake.mts` — stubbed fetch proving SSRF rejection of a private host, auth header, parameterization, JSON_ARRAY mapping incl. malformed-row rejection, PENDING→poll, and that no state mutation/campaign creation happens server-side.
    24	- **Rock W5 — gate + wiring**: all new tests in npm chain; full gate green. Proof: `npx tsc --noEmit && npm test` exit 0; `npm run lint` 0 errors.
    25	
    26	Order: W1 → W2+W4 (parallel-safe: disjoint files) → W3 (consumes W1+W2) → W5.

item.text:
nit: W1 — predicate is now correct and buildable: real contacted requires `OutreachMessage.dryRun === false AND sentAt != null` or provider/server ledger terminal `status:'sent'`; this matches manual LinkedIn confirm and provider-send transitions, and excludes demo dry-run sent plus live approved-unsent (PLAN-wave2.md:20, ../src/lib/store.ts:2537, ../src/lib/store.ts:2560, ../src/lib/store.ts:2660, ../src/lib/store.ts:2685, ../src/lib/store.ts:2817, ../src/lib/store.ts:2821).

nit: W2 — touchCount now correctly consumes W1 completed-send facts instead of raw outreachHistory or dryRun-only checks; cap, private export boundary, and messageId-to-outreach join are sufficient to build (PLAN-wave2.md:21).

nit: W3 — exec dashboard is sound if it calls the canonical W1 derivation rather than re-implementing filters locally; RBAC, demo banner, synthetic exclusion, and proof coverage are adequate (PLAN-wave2.md:22).

nit: W4 — Databricks route/config design remains sound: dedicated DatabricksSettings, `api_keys` only for the secret, `assertPublicUrl`, private-link out of scope, proposed drafts only, and no server mutation proof (PLAN-wave2.md:23).

nit: Plan text — the older “Verified seams” summary still contains stale shorthand (`touchCount = outreachHistory.length`, Databricks rows to `createCampaignFromAnalysis`), but the Rocks override it concretely enough for implementation (PLAN-wave2.md:11, PLAN-wave2.md:14, PLAN-wave2.md:20, PLAN-wave2.md:23).

VERDICT: APPROVED
